items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1969-12-04
items.q: MCA, like everybody else, would give you a throw off of Tommy Darcy, and wind up with Joe McGluck, and that's who you got.

ctx.x: You think the band wasn't any good when you bid $350?

Well, MCA, like everybody else, would give you a throw off of Tommy Darcy, and wind up with Joe McGluck, and that's who you got. You know what I mean? But the edgewater, Mr. Shoemaker had been a bellboy when I played at the White House. He loved me, he liked me, he knew I played good music, and he knew he could trust me. Just the same as Seymour Weiss told me, Johnny, when you own that band stand, you represent me. Because I remember one night the headweather got smart because I didn't ask him if I could play…
But I've had something in the situation.
